query: Please implement a web push notification system to send notifications to browsers. The system should have functionalities for subscribing to push notifications, triggering push notifications, and receiving push notifications. Users should be able to subscribe to push notifications in their browsers, and when the server triggers a push notification, the browser should be able to receive the notification even when it is not active or minimized. The system should support multiple browsers, such as Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Select navajo white for layout background and tan for component details.
